repos.description: Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦

aiSummary.summary: Colibri 是一个纯 C 语言编写的零依赖推理引擎，旨在运行参数量达 744B 到 2.8T 的前沿 MoE 模型。它通过将存储、内存和显存视为统一的层级，实现专家流式加载，降低对稀缺硬件的依赖，支持多种主流模型家族。
aiSummary.summary_en: Pure C inference engine for massive frontier MoE models, treating storage, RAM, and VRAM as a single multitier hierarchy.
aiSummary.useCase: 在消费级或异构硬件上运行超大参数量的前沿 MoE 模型，进行低成本的大模型推理研究。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Run massive frontier MoE models on consumer hardware with zero dependencies.

repos.description: Ever® Gauzy™ - Open Business Management Platform (ERP/CRM/HRM/ATS/PM) - https://gauzy.co

aiSummary.summary: Ever Gauzy 是一个基于 TypeScript 的开源商业管理平台，集成了 ERP、CRM、HRM、ATS 和项目管理等模块。它提供从财务、人力资源到销售的全流程管理解决方案，支持 Headless API，具备时间追踪、绩效监控、库存管理及会计开票等功能，旨在为协作经济提供一站式企业级服务。
aiSummary.summary_en: Open-source business management platform covering ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, and project management.
aiSummary.useCase: 适合需要一体化管理企业资源、客户关系、人力资源及项目进度的各类组织。
aiSummary.useCase_en: A comprehensive solution for managing enterprise resources, customer relationships, and employee productivity.

repos.description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.

aiSummary.summary: 这是一个基于浏览器的间谍卫星模拟器，利用真实数据提供逼真的3D地球。它实时追踪飞机、船只、卫星、地震、交通及公共摄像头，支持语音控制，无需API密钥即可本地运行。用户可体验驾驶舱视角飞行，点击追踪目标，并查看周围实时联系人。该项目开源且可扩展，将全球公开信号整合为可探索的交互式地图。
aiSummary.summary_en: A photorealistic 3D globe simulator tracking live aircraft, ships, and satellites using public data in the browser.
aiSummary.useCase: 全球实时空间情报可视化与监控
aiSummary.useCase_en: Visualize real-time global data such as aircraft, ships, and traffic on a 3D globe for spatial intelligence and explorat

repos.description: The secure, validated skill registry for professional AI coding agents. Extend Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and more with absolute confidence.

aiSummary.summary: 这是一个为专业 AI 编码代理提供的安全、经过验证的技能注册表。通过静态分析、人工策展和 Snyk 扫描确保技能库的安全性，解决了开放市场中 13% 技能存在漏洞的问题。支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等多种主流 AI 编码工具，提供可扩展的插件化能力。
aiSummary.summary_en: A secure, validated skill registry for professional AI coding agents to extend capabilities safely.
aiSummary.useCase: 为 Claude Code、Cursor 等主流 AI 编码代理提供安全、可验证的插件扩展，提升开发效率。
aiSummary.useCase_en: To provide a secure, validated library of skills for extending AI coding agents like Claude and Cursor.

repos.description: Open-source AI sales OS — self-hosted CRM with native AI agents + WhatsApp (WAHA). Open alternative to Kommo, Octadesk & Intercom for any business that sells by chat. MCP-ready, multi-tenant, LGPD.

aiSummary.summary: DeskcommCRM 是一个开源的 AI 销售操作系统，基于 TypeScript 开发。它提供自托管的 CRM 功能，集成了原生 AI 代理，专门用于 WhatsApp 营销。作为 Kommo、Octadesk 和 Intercom 的开源替代方案，它支持多租户和 LGPD 合规，帮助企业通过聊天进行销售。
aiSummary.summary_en: Open-source AI sales OS with self-hosted CRM and WhatsApp agents.
aiSummary.useCase: 适用于需要通过 WhatsApp 进行客户管理和自动销售流程的中小企业。
aiSummary.useCase_en: A self-hosted CRM solution for businesses to automate sales and customer service via WhatsApp.

repos.description: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files. Turn your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.

aiSummary.summary: OpenMontage 是世界上首个开源、代理驱动的视频制作系统。它包含 12 个生产管道和 700+ 代理技能，能将 AI 编码助手转化为全功能视频工作室。不仅能制作基于图像的视频，还能利用开源素材库生成包含真实运动片段的成品视频，涵盖从概念、脚本到剪辑、渲染的全流程。
aiSummary.summary_en: Open-source agentic video production system that transforms AI coding assistants into full video studios using 12 pipelines.
aiSummary.useCase: 适合需要自动化视频制作流程、利用 AI 生成高质量影视内容或短片的项目。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Automate video production workflows from concept to rendering, enabling the creation of cinematic trailers and animated

repos.description: Extracted system prompts from Anthropic - Claude Fable 5.1, Opus 5, Claude Design, Claude Code. OpenAI - ChatGPT GPT-6-Astra, Codex. Google - Gemini 3.8 Flash, 3.1 Pro, Antigravity. xAI - Grok, Grok Bot, Cursor, Kimi and more! Updated regularly.

aiSummary.summary: 该项目收集并整理了来自Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、xAI等主流大模型的泄露系统提示词，涵盖Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、Grok等。内容定期更新，被媒体用于分析AI行为，帮助开发者了解大模型的底层指令和规则。
aiSummary.summary_en: Repository containing leaked system prompts for major AI models like Claude, ChatGPT, and Grok.
aiSummary.useCase: 用于研究大模型底层逻辑、媒体数据分析及AI行为分析。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Researchers and journalists use these prompts to analyze AI behavior and hidden rules.

repos.description: Fully autonomous AI Agents system capable of performing complex penetration testing tasks

aiSummary.summary: Pentagi 是一个基于 Go 语言开发的完全自主 AI Agent 系统，专注于执行复杂的渗透测试任务。项目采用前后端分离架构，包含后端服务、前端界面及可观测性模块，支持通过 Docker 快速部署。它利用 AI 技术自动化安全测试流程，旨在提升渗透测试的效率与深度。
aiSummary.summary_en: Go-based autonomous AI agents for complex penetration testing tasks.
aiSummary.useCase: 用于自动化执行复杂的渗透测试任务，提升安全评估效率。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Perform complex penetration testing tasks using autonomous AI agents.

repos.description: YuE2: frontier music generation with symbolic planning, zero-shot covers, and agentic music editing.

aiSummary.summary: YuE2 是一个前沿的音乐生成项目，通过符号化规划实现高质量音乐创作。它支持文本生成歌曲、零样本翻唱和代理式音乐编辑，允许用户在渲染前查看和编辑乐谱，并能通过对话进行风格转换和歌曲优化。
aiSummary.summary_en: YuE2 is a frontier music generation model that unifies symbolic and audio generation using symbolic planning, zero-shot covers, and agentic editing.
aiSummary.useCase: 文本生成高质量音乐、零样本翻唱及基于代理的音乐编辑
aiSummary.useCase_en: Generate frontier quality music from lyrics and style prompts using symbolic planning and agentic editing.

repos.description: Browse media content with your own rules on Android TV

aiSummary.summary: SmartTube 是一款专为 Android TV 设计的开源媒体客户端，允许用户在电视优化界面下浏览和播放内容。它支持 8K、HDR、SponsorBlock 等高级功能，且无需 Google 服务。开发者近期报告了安全事件，建议用户检查权限。目前不支持手机和平板，主要面向电视用户。
aiSummary.summary_en: Free and open-source media client for Android TV optimized for browsing and playing content.
aiSummary.useCase: 在 Android TV 设备上替代官方 YouTube 客户端，享受无 Google 服务、SponsorBlock 等高级功能。
aiSummary.useCase_en: To browse and play media content on Android TV with a clean interface and custom rules.

repos.description: Run parallel research agents with any model

aiSummary.summary: OpenResearch 是一个基于 Rust 的本地优先研究工作空间，旨在运行并行研究代理。它支持 Claude Code、Codex 等工具，允许用户进行文献综述、假设开发和实验。核心特性包括并行探索、基于 Git 的可重现实验、上下文证据管理以及自动研究循环。支持本地或云端计算，适合研究人员进行自主科研。
aiSummary.summary_en: A Rust-based local-first workspace for running parallel research agents and autoresearch.
aiSummary.useCase: 适用于研究人员利用 AI 代理进行文献综述、假设开发及实验验证的自主科研场景。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Turn AI coding assistants like Cursor into autonomous research agents to run experiments and manage workflows.

repos.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.

aiSummary.summary: VoiceStudio 是一个开源、完全本地化的 ElevenLabs 替代品，基于 Python 开发。它支持语音克隆、视频配音、听写、转录和有声书创作，覆盖 646 种语言。项目提供 16 个 TTS 和 11 个 ASR 引擎，无需账户或订阅，支持多种硬件加速，目前处于活跃 Beta 阶段。
aiSummary.summary_en: Open-source, local alternative to ElevenLabs offering voice cloning, dubbing, and transcription in 646 languages.
aiSummary.useCase: 适合需要完全本地化、隐私保护的语音合成与处理，以及多语言视频配音和有声书创作的个人或开发者。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Run local voice cloning, video dubbing, and transcription workflows on personal hardware.

repos.description: claude-red is a curated library of offensive security skills designed for the Claude skills system. Each skill is a structured SKILL.md file that primes Claude with expert-level methodology for a specific attack surface — from SQLi to shellcode, EDR evasion to exploit development.

aiSummary.summary: 这是一个针对 Claude AI 的攻击性安全技能库，包含 SQL 注入、Shellcode、EDR 绕过等专业技能。通过结构化的 SKILL.md 文件，Claude 可根据对话上下文按需加载特定领域的攻击方法论，适用于授权红队、漏洞赏金和安全研究。
aiSummary.summary_en: A curated library of offensive security skills for the Claude AI system to act as a red team operator.
aiSummary.useCase: 授权红队演练、漏洞赏金挖掘、安全研究及 CTF 备赛
aiSummary.useCase_en: Turn Claude into a domain specialist for authorized red team engagements and security research.

repos.description: Fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.

aiSummary.summary: 阿里巴巴开源的 AI 代码审查 CLI 工具，采用混合架构（确定性管道+LLM Agent），能生成高精度的行级评论。内置多语言规则集，支持读取完整文件和搜索代码库进行深度审查。相比通用 Agent，它在相同模型下精度更高、耗 Token 更少，专为大规模生产环境设计。
aiSummary.summary_en: Alibaba's battle-tested AI code review tool using Go and LLMs for precise, fast, and efficient analysis.
aiSummary.useCase: 适用于需要高精度、低误报的代码审查场景，特别是大型企业级项目的自动化质量保障。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Configure an LLM endpoint to perform fast, precise, and battle-tested AI code reviews on Git diffs.

repos.description: 🤖📐专为数学建模设计的 Agent & skills ,自动完成数学建模，生成一份完整的可以直接提交的论文。 An Agent Designed for Mathematical Modeling ,Automatically complete mathmodel and generate a complete paper ready for submission.

aiSummary.summary: 这是一个专为数学建模设计的开源 Agent 项目，利用 Python 和 SKILLS 技术实现全流程自动化。它能自动分析问题、建模、编写代码、绘图并生成排版精美的论文。支持多 Agent 协作、RAG 知识库检索、Web 搜索及人机交互，内置多种竞赛模板和验收机制，旨在将建模时间从三天缩短至一小时。
aiSummary.summary_en: An AI agent that automates mathematical modeling and generates complete competition papers.
aiSummary.useCase: 数学建模竞赛（如国赛、MCM/ICM）的自动化辅助与论文生成
aiSummary.useCase_en: Automating the entire mathematical modeling workflow to generate competition-ready papers.

repos.description: Download Udemy and Hotmart courses, YouTube videos, music and books — 1,800+ sites, no terminal. Free open-source desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux, with a built-in course player, PDF/EPUB reader and music library. Powered by yt-dlp. Your files stay on your computer.

repos.description: A practical Douyin downloader for both single-item and profile batch downloads, with progress display, retries, SQLite deduplication, and browser fallback support. 抖音批量下载工具，去水印，支持视频、图集、合集、音乐(原声)。

aiSummary.summary: 这是一个功能全面的抖音视频下载工具，支持单视频、图集、合集、音乐及个人主页批量下载。具备去水印、进度显示、断点续传、SQLite去重及完整性校验等功能。项目还提供了一个名为Douzy的桌面应用，支持抖音、TikTok和YouTube多平台，提供可视化的任务管理和本地归档功能。
aiSummary.summary_en: A Python-based downloader for Douyin, TikTok, and YouTube content featuring batch processing, SQLite deduplication, and a desktop GUI.
aiSummary.useCase: 适合需要批量下载抖音视频、图集或音乐，以及管理个人收藏夹内容的用户。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Download public videos, photo posts, and profiles from Douyin, TikTok, and YouTube without signing in.

repos.description: A good looking terminal emulator which mimics the old cathode display...

aiSummary.summary: cool-retro-term 是一款模仿老式阴极射线管显示器的终端模拟器。它外观精美、可自定义且轻量级。基于 QML 和 qmltermwidget 构建，支持 Linux 和 macOS，提供复古的视觉体验和丰富的设置选项。
aiSummary.summary_en: A visually appealing terminal emulator mimicking old cathode tube screens using QML and Qt6.
aiSummary.useCase: 适合追求复古视觉体验、喜欢个性化终端界面的用户在 Linux 和 macOS 上使用。
aiSummary.useCase_en: For users seeking a customizable, lightweight terminal emulator with a retro cathode display aesthetic.

repos.description: 🤗 Transformers: the model-definition framework for state-of-the-art machine learning models in text, vision, audio, and multimodal models, for both inference and training.

aiSummary.summary: Hugging Face Transformers 是一个支持文本、视觉、音频及多模态模型的机器学习框架。它集成了超过 100 万个预训练模型检查点，旨在简化 SOTA 模型的使用。该库与多种训练和推理框架兼容，提供 Pipeline API，方便开发者进行模型推理和训练，推动机器学习技术的普及。
aiSummary.summary_en: A Python framework for state-of-the-art machine learning models in text, vision, audio, and multimodal tasks.
aiSummary.useCase: 用于文本、视觉、音频及多模态模型的推理与训练开发。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Run state-of-the-art machine learning models for inference and training across text, vision, and audio.
